verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant find deals, update records and automate workflows, plus a REST API (v1/v2, OpenAPI spec) with lead, person and organization endpoints, so an agent can manipulate lead and company records programmatically. However, the evidence never explicitly shows creating a lead, filling company data, or setting an owner through the API or MCP. Automatic lead assignment is documented only as a workflow-automation feature, which is adjacent rather than agent-driven. missing for 10: documented create-lead endpoint/MCP tool, company-data enrichment capability, explicit owner-assignment via API/MCP, end-to-end agent walkthrough, independent hands-on corroboration.
